reason: ProviderScheduler.settle() read the turn only inside correlated EXISTS/scalar subqueries; ExecutionSQLScope refuses that shape (the bare entities table is not mapped by the outer statement), so every project worker's recovery pass failed and queued/parked admissions of ended turns never closed, inflating queue positions and metrics and blocking project retirement and Core shutdown. The read now joins the turn so the scope fences it through loader criteria. Selected suites cover the execution scope (new worker settle regression on sqlite and PostgreSQL), recovery settle, admission cleanup, queue positions, runtime switching, handoff participants and admission, host load/pressure and runtime capacity.
